rows.grounds: present passive participle describing one undergoing cutting
optative expressing potential or hypothetical non-cutting
compound indicating one who has reached that state
compound indicating one whose mind is absorbed in that

items.question: Can absorption in that state prevent harm when the body is being cut?
premises: A person may be physically subjected to cutting.
A person can be gone to that state with mind fixed on that.
Absorption in that state alters the effect of physical injury.
items.inference: One who has gone to that state and whose mind is fixed on it is not truly cut even while being cut.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'that' depends on the preceding context.
It is unclear whether the invulnerability is literal or experiential.
items.plain_english: One who has gone to that and whose mind is fixed on it, even while being cut, is not cut.
